spell.technomagy.erode.description: Terra's strata met with Aer's restlessness: grit saltated grain by grain until mountains were levelled by the same arithmetic that carved the canyons (Latin: rodere, to gnaw - whence erodere). The dwarves call it the enemy of the deep-roads; the geologist calls it time. Give the wind ten thousand years and it becomes a sculptor - sufficiently advanced patience is indistinguishable from force.
spell.technomagy.forge.description: Terra's salt meets Ignis's sulfur at the critical temperature: iron's lattice yields and recrystallises, remembering the hammer in its grain, while the temper's colours - thin-film interference on the oxide skin - tell the smith by sight what a pyrometer tells by number. The alchemists watched those colours in their athanor and named the work calcination; the dwarves name it craft. Any furnace hot enough to unmake the metal's old shape is, to the metal, indistinguishable from a spell.
spell.technomagy.lightning.description: Aer's breath given Ignis's temper: the sky's field climbs until air - an insulator a moment before - ionises into a plasma channel five times hotter than the sun's surface, and thunder is merely the air confessing to the sudden vacancy (Latin: fulmen, the darter). Franklin tamed it with a wire; Karsus answered it with a crown. A spark crossing a mile of nothing, carrying a whole cloud's argument - sufficiently advanced voltage is indistinguishable from wrath.
spell.technomagy.steam.description: Aqua boiled by Ignis until it will no longer be contained: the latent heat hiding in every droplet released as pressure, the Carnot cycle distilled to its honest limit, and the second law taking its percentage at each stroke. This is the spell that built the workshops - a boiler is a promise of motion, kept. Any engine whose workings are sufficiently hidden is, to the bystander, indistinguishable from a spell; cover the pistons and call it sorcery.
spell.technomagy.mist.description: Aer holding Aqua in suspension: droplets too small to settle, each a lens scattering the light blue-ward (Rayleigh, who explained the sky in an afternoon), the dew point crossed and the world's edges dissolved. The watchfires of Cormanthor burned just so through it; a road hidden by fog does not exist to whoever walks it. The eye surrenders to an arithmetic it cannot count.
spell.technomagy.constraint.description: Terra's body with Aqua's grip: pore water pressed between grains until the ground forgets whether it is solid or liquid - the quickclay that walks like a hill and collapses like a soup (Latin: vinculum, the bond). Rheology gives it a yield stress; the spell gives it an opinion: nothing crosses. What is held, holds.
spell.technomagy.ward.description: Terra's lattice set in Lux's order: a crystal is a fortress of arithmetic - every atom in its station - and light bent to a geometry will follow that geometry anywhere (total internal reflection: the pipe that carries the sea's own light). The archmages of Netheril cut their glyph-wards on this principle, and the alchemists drew the sigillum and stood inside it. A boundary sufficiently ordered is indistinguishable from a wall.
spell.technomagy.entomb.description: Terra closing over Tenebrae's silence: without oxygen even rot is denied its work, and bodies become documents - the Tollund man's last meal legible after two millennia, coal the compressed patience of forests. Pressure and dark keep what light would spend (Latin: sepelire, to bury). The crypt-lords of Karrnath build on this arithmetic: what is buried correctly is buried indefinitely.
spell.technomagy.reveal.description: Aer clarified by Lux: haze is only Rayleigh scattering arguing with distance, and every element announces itself in spectral lines no tongue can forge - read the light and the light names its owners (Latin: lux manifesta, the light made plain). The court wizards' scrying pools do by water what the spectroscope does by glass. Nothing hides from a patient reading of the light that left it - which is why the wise fear questions more than spells.
spell.technomagy.shroud.description: Aer persuaded toward Tenebrae: a surface that returns no signal is a surface that does not exist to the seeker - anti-reflective coatings thinner than a wavelength, soot's old trick now measured in nanometres (Latin: tenebrae, the darkness that keeps). Shar's Shadow Weave is the same discipline practised without equipment: to shroud a thing is to deny the light its testimony. What cannot be seen is not merely hidden - it is untrue.
spell.technomagy.radiance.description: Ignis clothed in Lux: a body glows as its temperature dictates - Wien's law reading colour like a thermometer, the Stefan-Boltzmann fourth power charging every degree twice over - until lamp and star stand revealed as one phenomenon at different prices (Latin: radiare, to beam). The alchemists aimed the Great Work at exactly this: the stone that shines. The Morninglord's dawn is the same equation, unpaid.
spell.technomagy.blight.description: Ignis without its light, Tenebrae without its rest: oxidation that keeps the heat and skips the flame, free radicals stealing from living tissue one electron at a time (Latin: rubigo, the rust that walks). The farmlands of the Moonsea know the signature - green retreating from the leaf's edge like a tide. Entropy does not hate the orchard; it simply bills everything, and blight is the reminder sent.
spell.technomagy.mend.description: Aqua carrying Lux's instruction: cells swollen back to their proper shape by osmosis, the solvent carrying the right reagent to the broken bond (Latin: sanare, to make whole), and light of the right wavelength coaxing the wound to close faster than darkness allows (photobiomodulation, measured in clinics). The alchemists bottled the principle as aqua vitae; the clergy bottle it as prayer. Healing is chemistry with the patience removed.
spell.technomagy.leach.description: Aqua serving Tenebrae: the solvent that takes rather than gives - chelators gripping metal out of stone, a poison plume walking the water table for miles without a sound (Latin: lixivium, the lye drawn from ash). Paracelsus wrote the rule the spell obeys: the poison is in the dose. The necrotic touch works the same ledger - what the water carries away, the victim never gets back.
spell.technomagy.growth.description: The trinity of the leaf: Lux captured by chlorophyll (red and blue taken, green returned as the plant's signature colour), Aqua split for its electrons, Terra's carbon drawn from the air into sugar by the Calvin cycle's quiet industry - and turgor pressure inflating every cell like a small hydraulic lift (Latin: crescere, to grow). The druids of the Realms perform this rite nightly without knowing its name; a forest is a spell that has finished casting.
spell.technomagy.life_and_death.descript: Lux and Tenebrae keeping one ledger: every living thing is a temporary negotiation with the second law - Schrodinger's answer, that life feeds on negative entropy - and death is not the end of the negotiation but its scheduled audit (apoptosis: the body's own orderly demolition). Light hands out the energy; Dark keeps the books (Latin: vita et mors, una lex). Mystra and Shar disagree only about which half is mercy; the spell presents the invoice.
message.technomagy.select_spell: Assign and select a Technomagy spell in Ability Hotbar.
message.technomagy.invalid_target: That spell cannot affect this target.
mastery.technomagy.fire.description: Ignis, the hot and dry - thermodynamics' own arrow, matter loosened until it glows: every body radiates as its heat allows, a lamp and a star differing by degree rather than kind, and plasma is merely matter that has forgotten how to be solid. The alchemists called its soul sulfur, first of the tria prima; the Weave answers their furnace with wrath. Mastery of Ignis deepens whenever a Fire spell earns mastery - the arrow that points only forward, every success fed back into the furnace the alchemists coaxed with solve et coagula. Its level strengthens Forge, Lightning, Steam, Radiance and Blight, returning to Lightning and Steam as mightier force and to Radiance and Blight as a longer glow.
mastery.technomagy.earth.description: Terra, the cold and dry - the salt of the tria prima, body made stable: crystals grow by slow arithmetic, strata remember every age in stone, and pressure that bends rock will bend a promise. The dwarven deep-roads and the geologist's core sample read the same record; the alchemists named it the Body. Mastery of Terra deepens whenever an Earth spell earns mastery - the Body's slow arithmetic, patience compounded into strata the way a geologist reads a core sample. Its level strengthens Erode, Forge, Constraint, Ward, Entomb and Growth, returning to Ward as both mightier force and longer hold, to Growth as mightier force, and to Constraint and Entomb as a longer hold.
mastery.technomagy.air.description: Aer, the hot and wet - the restless one: Bernoulli's law written into every gust, sound itself nothing but pressure confiding in the ear, and the ideal gas indifferent to which vessel holds it. Mercury, the tria prima's mobile soul, rides it; in the Realms the same restlessness answers to wind-walking. Mastery of Aer deepens whenever an Air spell earns mastery - the restless one, learning the way Bernoulli's gusts learn the cliff face: by wearing a path through it. Its level strengthens Erode, Lightning, Mist, Reveal and Shroud, returning to Lightning as mightier force, to Mist and Shroud as a longer veil, and to Reveal as a longer sight.
mastery.technomagy.water.description: Aqua, the cold and wet - the universal solvent, the alchemists' aqua permanens that dissolves to purify: hydrogen bonds breaking and reforming faster than counting, mixing always toward the entropy it prefers. It is the Body's loosener and the wine of life; the Weave's rivers run on the same chemistry. Mastery of Aqua deepens whenever a Water spell earns mastery - the universal solvent at longer work, dissolving not to destroy but to purify, the alchemists' aqua permanens. Its level strengthens Mist, Constraint, Mend and Leach, returning to Mend as mightier force and to Mist, Constraint and Leach as a longer grip.
mastery.technomagy.light.description: Lux, fiat lux: photons in the inverse-square discipline, refraction bending each colour by its own impatience, and every element announcing itself in spectral lines no tongue can forge. The alchemists chased it as gold, the rubedo at the end of the Great Work; Mystra's Weave is said to shine with this arithmetic. Mastery of Lux deepens whenever a Light spell earns mastery - the rubedo the alchemists chased, each revelation another spectral line in a spectrum that now answers to its bearer. Its level strengthens Ward, Reveal, Radiance, Mend, Growth and Life & Death, returning to Ward both gifts, to Mend, Growth and Life & Death mightier force, and to Reveal and Radiance a longer radiance.
mastery.technomagy.dark.description: Tenebrae, not an absence but a claim: every photon refused, shadow cast wherever light is denied, and the oldest equation in the room - heat, given time, spends itself. Shar keeps the Shadow Weave for what the light forgets; the alchemists called it the nigredo, the blackening that must precede all transformation. Mastery of Tenebrae deepens whenever a Dark spell earns mastery - the nigredo kept deliberately, for the blackening that precedes all transformation is also a discipline. Its level strengthens Entomb, Shroud, Blight, Leach and Life & Death, returning to Life & Death as mightier force and to Entomb, Shroud, Blight and Leach as a longer dark.
